explanation_text: Input [latex]x(t)=2 \cos (2 t) [/latex] Frequency response [latex] \begin{aligned} X(\omega)&=2 \pi[\delta(\omega-2)+\delta(\omega+2)]\\ H(\omega)&=\frac{1}{2+j \omega} \\ \text{output}\quad Y(\omega)&=H(\omega) X(\omega) \end{aligned}[/latex] [latex] \begin{array}{l} =\frac{1}{2+j \omega} \cdot 2 \pi[\delta(\omega-2)+\delta(\omega+2)] \\ =\frac{2 \pi}{2+j 2} \delta(\omega-2)+\frac{2 \pi}{2-j 2} \delta(\omega+2) \\ =\frac{2 \pi}{8}[(2-j 2) \delta(\omega-2)+(2+j 2) \delta(\omega+2)] \\ \left.=\frac{\pi}{4}[2\{\delta(\omega-2)+\delta(\omega+2)\}+j 2\{\delta(\omega)+2)-\delta(\omega-2)\}\right] \\ =\frac{\pi}{2}[\delta(\omega-2)+\delta(\omega+2)]-j \frac{\pi}{2}[\delta(\omega-2)-\delta(\omega+2)] \\ \therefore \quad y(t)=\frac{\cos 2 t}{2}+\frac{\sin 2 t}{2} \\ =\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\left[\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos 2 t+\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \sin 2 t\right] \\ =\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos (2 t-0.25 \pi) \\ =2^{-0.5} \cos (2 t-0.25 \pi) \end{array}[/latex]
